name: QuickBooks Online
description: Industry standard small business accounting with automatic bank feeds and multi-currency transaction syncing.
fullDescription: Intuit QuickBooks Online is the gold standard cloud accounting software for growing e-commerce businesses. Featuring automated bank feeds, robust inventory reconciliation, and multi-currency exchange rate adjustments, it provides clear profit-and-loss statements for tax filing and investor reporting.
features: Automated bank account and corporate credit card transaction feeds
Multi-currency transaction recording with automated exchange gain/loss splits
Integration with e-commerce bookkeeping tools like A2X and Webgility
Comprehensive real-time balance sheet, profit & loss, and cash flow reporting
Secure multi-user permissions for bookkeepers, accountants, and executives
